'''2001 Clarks Summit tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Clarks Summit on 2001. [[Mark Mattingly]] won it. It is known from Jake Rich's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2941">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-2-or-bust-clarks-summitd2941/ 2-or-bust-clarks-summit], DeckTech (Jake "NeDraco" Rich, 6 September 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-09-06-2-or-bust-clarks-summitd2941/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 2001
* '''Site:''' Clarks Summit
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Mark Mattingly]]
